A '''person''' served the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Knight]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The Knight fell under the direct command of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], the leader of the Sith Empire, and also [[Sith training|trained]] the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Voren]].<ref name="BODR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Knight was mentioned in ''[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement that was written by [[Patrick Stutzman]] and published in [[August]] [[2008]].<ref name="BODR" />
